items.label: BOOSTS ENERGY AND FOCUS
items.value: Promotes healthy posture, core strength, and increases blood flow to improve concentration and balance. Kids can straddle and bounce while getting the wiggles out. Ideal for boys and girls.

items.label: GET THE WIGGLES OUT
items.value: A flexible active seat made for high-energy, active, or wiggly kids who will enjoy a unique form of fitness and a fun way of being seated.

items.label: GRAB THEIR ATTENTION
items.value: Ball movements encourage blood flow to the brain that results in increased attentiveness, decreased restlessness, and lack of boredom and distractions at home or in the classroom.

items.label: MULTI-PURPOSE
items.value: Balance ball can be used as a desk, computer, fidget, office chair in the classroom or at home for reading, studying, gaming or watching TV and movies, as well as for remote learning.

items.label: PEANUT SHAPE
items.value: Ball chair offers more stability than traditional balance balls because of the unique cradling shape, which offers more fun and safety for your little one.
